description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkAudioPlayer component, specifically testing audio playback behaviors such as handling end or failure of playback and concurrent play calls, along with some helper functions and error definitions.

classes.name: TimeoutError
classes.description: A custom Error type used to signal a timeout in asynchronous operations.

methods.name: withTimeout
methods.description: Executes a given asynchronous work with a timeout, throwing a TimeoutError if the work does not complete within the specified time.

methods.name: makeWav16Mono
methods.description: Generates a WAV format Data object with silence samples for testing purposes.
